contracts: (RMAP-S2 passes only when all three named seed occurrences are unique and complete, and fails when any occurrence lacks required provenance metadata.) AND (The aggregate validator cannot return a passing or authorizing result without the required matrix evidence.)
selector_intents: Remove provenance metadata from one named seed occurrence in the evaluation-seed manifest fixture and require RMAP-S2 validation failure.
Run the RMAP-S2 aggregate validator against the existing evaluation artifact set with its required matrix receipt removed from the selector fixture.
